name: What's the difference between a custom-tiled shower and a pre-fabricated unit?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a custom-tiled shower and a pre-fabricated unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom-tiled showers offer endless design possibilities, allowing for personalized sizes, shapes, tile patterns, and integrated features like benches or niches. They typically involve more labor and a higher cost but provide a unique, high-end finish. Pre-fabricated shower units, conversely, are factory-made and come in standard sizes and designs. They are generally quicker to install and more budget-friendly. While offering less customization, they are a practical and durable choice. Alpha-Plumbing Services can help you weigh the pros and cons of both options for your installation in Goodyear or Buckeye.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom-tiled showers offer personalized design and higher cost, while pre-fabricated units are standard, quicker to install, and more budget-friendly.
